BackupEngine.doc: The storage-side backup state machine. Holds the source and destination Database references (target-rendered as borrows / handles), the cursor over pages still to copy (the pending set, with page 1 deferred per Pin E5), and the snapshot scalars captured at open / restart (src_page_size, src_pagecount_observed, src_change_counter_observed, dst_pre_init_size). Targets MAY render the pending-set cursor as a 1-based bitmap, a counter + 'page 1 done' flag, or a list; the spec only pins that |pending| is the value returned by backup_engine_remaining and that page 1 is yielded last.

EngineState.doc: States of the backup-engine state machine. Idle is the post-open / pre-first-step state. Copying is entered on the first non-zero step. RestartRequired is entered when a source-write is detected; the next step transitions back to Copying. Completed is terminal modulo release. RolledBack is the terminal state after release-while-not-Completed.

EngineStepOutcome.doc: Outcome of a backup_engine_step call. Progressed means the cursor advanced (or the step was a no-op for n_pages=0, or a restart was triggered — both surfaced as Progressed per Pin B4 / Pin B12). Completed means the entire pass finished and dst_commit ran. Failed wraps a RuntimeCondition that the lib-api translates into BackupStepResult::Error.

backup_engine_open.doc: Acquire the destination's exclusive write-lock and capture the source's snapshot scalars (page count, change counter, page size). Returns Err on lock contention, on UnknownSchema, or on PageSizeMismatch. The returned engine has state=Idle.

backup_engine_step.doc: Copy up to n_pages source pages into the destination. n_pages == 0 returns Progressed without acquiring any lock. n_pages > 0 acquires the source's shared read-lock, checks the source's change-counter for source-write-since-last-step, and either restarts the pass or copies up to n_pages non-page-1 pages. When the pending set (modulo page 1) becomes empty, page 1 is copied and dst_commit is invoked, returning Completed. The lib-api translates Completed into BackupStepResult::Done.

backup_engine_release.doc: Release the destination's exclusive write-lock and free engine resources. If state is Completed, this is a clean release (the dst commit already happened in the final step). Otherwise, the destination is rolled back: pager_rollback on a pre-existing destination, file-truncate-to-zero on a fresh destination. Idempotent (Pin E11).

backup_engine_remaining.doc: Cardinality of the pending set (including page 1 if still deferred). Pinned by Pin E14 as the canonical definition of the lib-api's backup_remaining accessor. O(1) read.

backup_engine_pagecount.doc: Source page count as observed at the most recent open or restart (engine.src_pagecount_observed). The lib-api's backup_pagecount accessor delegates here. O(1) read.

backup_engine_state.doc: Current state of the engine. Used by the lib-api's finish to decide between clean release and rollback (Pin B6 / Pin E11).
